reviews.t: One of the best spray bottles
reviews.x: This bottle is sturdy, see-through and has an excellent spray.  Also comes with a cover.  I had purchased some philosophy body spray that just came in a bottle with no spray.  Filled them in these bottles and they work great.  Can label them very easily.  Can also put hairspray from Sally's Beauty that comes in the jug.  And these are unbreakable.  Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Good spritzer, dip tube twice as long as it needs to be.
reviews.x: Used these for liquid hand sanitizer! Did the trick! I was looking for a way to dispense without waist. The dip tube for the sprayer is twice as long as it needs to be ....either cut or like I did just let it coil in the bottle. No problems yet and I have at least 20 of them around my work .

I am very, very disappointed with  this product.  I purchased it for my liquid hair spray.  I wanted a gentle soft spray, but I got a straight spray.  When I tried it with water, the spray was different - soft and even (which is what I wanted).  I would like to return these.

I ordered two sets of spray bottles. Disappointed that two of the bottles had squirt tops rather than spray tops.  In three of the bottles the straws were longer than the bottle itself causing them to curl inside the bottles.  I had to cut the straws to correct length.

After a few uses, the sprayer quits working.  I've been hoping that these would work for me because I like the size and color, but after just a few uses, you can push the spray button part way down, but nothing will come out.  I won't purchase these again.

reviews.t: Work perfect with Skin So Soft oil.
reviews.x: I needed the sprayers for some Avon Skin So Soft Bug Guard Plus because Avon did not provide them and it is a huge mess trying to apply the oil without them. These sprayers  fit the SSS bottles and they spray the oil in a fine mist. Perfect.

I am so happy that my bottles arrived.  The bottle are in great condition.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars, the bottles arrived much later than scheduled date of arrival.  Other than that I will certainly order again.  Thank you!

How many times have you spent your money on spray bottles only for them to stop working?  Sometimes it's only after a few uses.  I've used these bottles on several occasions with great delight.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the fine mist spray these bottles produce.
Several reviewers report the bottles do not leak.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including sticking or breaking spray nozzles.
A few reviewers complain the spray is not a fine mist as advertised, or that they received wrong or squirt tops instead of spray tops.
Some reviewers note the dip tubes are longer than needed and must be cut or coiled.
